summary: Admit bounded one-parcel 5Post universal order creation through the reviewed runtime.

impacts.evidence: The existing authenticated shipment command resolves tenant-scoped account configuration before the worker invokes the creator.
Product and recipient fields stay inside the existing callback-scoped payload and only normalized shipment identity/cost crosses the connector boundary.
OpenAPI and the generic shipment-create request gain additive optional item and money fields.
No event envelope or event schema changes.
The fivepost Transport and connector gain explicit non-secret configuration and product-aware create mapping.
The existing secret-backed shipment payload already carries the additive request fields.
Fixed-host HTTPS, callback-scoped credentials, bounded one-cargo writes, exact money arithmetic and response identity checks are mandatory.
The existing fulfillment shipment-create approval and write-sensitive policy boundary is reused.
The existing shipment mutation and operation receipt remain the audit boundary.
The external write is never retried after an ambiguous outcome and duplicate provider acknowledgement is rejected by the bounded adapter.
Only the fixed official 5Post host is used; no inbound callback is admitted.
Shared HTTP timeout, request/response limits and normalized error categories cover the write.
Removing the fivepost creator branch or support capability immediately closes order creation.
Deterministic tests cover configuration rejection, exact payload mapping, money relationships and success response identity.
